description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/column_nonuniform_1d/rules/sedimentation_jh2010_flux_D_lev: the compound D(W*q, lev) replaced by the rule's five-region makearray (layer 1; layer 2; the interior stencil aggregate over [3,6]; layer 7; the no-inflow top layer 8). Every binding loads fixture.esm (NLEV bound to 8 at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST with zero unlowered rewrite-target ops in evaluation position, zero surviving metaparameter names, the free-name geometry array dz surviving as index references, and the lev_nodes axis folded to size 9. Surviving apply_expression_template nodes for the match-less face stencils are expected (reference-preserving loader, esm-spec 9.6.4). No golden is committed with this fixture: the case is marked "status": "pending-golden", which scripts/compare-outputs.py reports as SKIP for the golden gate while STILL running the runner-output gate and the cross-binding-bytes gate. The golden is installed by scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh, which flips this status to "active", at the repo-wide regeneration (the ast corpus is pinned to the pre-0.9.0 loader).
